title: Make the claim sweep caller-aware, store-safe, and blocked-verdict
action: Give sweep_expired_claims (handlers_select.rs:62) a caller-session parameter and skip every claim whose own session field equals it, applying the exclusion before the .adopting gate is acquired - the existing heartbeat-then-gate order is pinned by tests.rs:2266-2271 and must survive. Update the single production caller at handlers_select.rs:519 to pass the session it already resolved at :517. Then change sweep_reset_cell (handlers_select.rs:174) from the claimed->open reset to the claimed->blocked verdict (per D4): write status blocked and write the reason at trace.blocked_reason, the same key bee cells block writes (handlers_close.rs:782) and bee cells reopen clears (handlers_close.rs:914) - a top-level key would be invisible to reopen and to feedback.rs:1045. The reason names the dead session id and the worktree path, resolved from the claim's optional workspace_id (claims.rs:692-711) through workspace_store.rs:16,174 to its root; when the claim carries no workspace_id or the workspace record is missing, the reason states that explicitly instead of omitting the clause, and a sessionless claim keeps the existing 'none (sessionless)' spelling pinned at tests.rs:2084. Per D5 the sweep never writes across a store boundary: it always removes the qualifying claim, but it parks the cell only when the cell record is readable in the sweeping process's own store - when it is not, write no cell anywhere and name the cell id and the holding worktree in both the command output and the decision row. Rewrite the decision-row rationale at handlers_select.rs:120-127, whose tail still reads 'returned to open rather than left claimed-but-unclaimable forever', so it states the blocked verdict. Judge existing coverage first: verbs/cells/tests.rs already holds sweep_resets_only_the_claim_it_actually_removed (:2004), sweep_of_a_sessionless_claim_names_none_in_its_decision_row (:2084) and sweep_skips_a_gated_claim_and_leaks_no_gate_file (:2219); three of them assert the claimed->open outcome (:2053, :2098, :2260) plus the decision text at :2074, and four call sites (:2041, :2078, :2094, :2248) need the new signature. Author only the gap: self-exclusion, the unreachable-cell path, the missing-workspace reason, and the boundary cases in the plan's test matrix rows 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9. Correct the stale claimed->open doc comments at verbs/cells/mod.rs:43-44 and handlers_select.rs:34, :60, :170.

truths: A claim owned by the calling session is never swept, even when its TTL is expired and its heartbeat is stale
A swept cell readable in the sweeper's own store becomes status blocked with trace.blocked_reason naming the dead session and the worktree path

A swept claim whose cell is not readable in the sweeper's own store still has its claim removed, has no cell record written in any store, and has its cell id and holding worktree named in the output and the decision row
A claim whose TTL is expired but whose owning session heartbeat is fresh is not swept, and the reverse is also not swept
bee cells reopen clears a blocked_reason written by the sweep
